title: ApertureSMP
description: A friendly community SMP with Bedrock support, gem economy, custom cosmetics, chest & grief protection, and more. Join the discord for more info!
body:
# ApertureSMP Season 2
A small, community-driven Minecraft SMP with Bedrock support.

![season 1 spawn](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/62ac1149bc866a64d7d1d26429f2f25726690fee.png)
## Server Info

| | |
|---|---|
| **Bedrock Support** | Yes |
| **Recommended Modpack** | Available - includes FPS optimization & QOL mods |

## Custom Features

- **Gem Economy** — Earn and trade gems as currency
- **Custom Tool Skins** - Personalize your weapons & tools
- **Hats** - Ability to customize your netherite helmet to over 40+ different unique hat models
- **Chest Protection** - Keep your items safe 
- **Grief Protection** - Rollback any griefed builds easily by messaging a mod or admin
- **Player Duels** - Challenge others to 1v1 fights
- **Custom Food Skins** - Unique looks for your food
